exposure: family-centered intervention in the NICU (education for fathers on mother supporting and newborn care, parental presence with infants for 3 days)
cohort: The study included 60 parents of premature infants hospitalized in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
finding: Family-centered intervention involving paternal support significantly reduced the anxiety scores of mothers of premature infants in the intervention group compared to a control group receiving routine care.
